description: Turn a request into a job at its property or address and link them both ways. The request's property becomes the job's home, and the job keeps the request. The worker then writes the quote or books a visit.

address.description: address is an object, not a string, with required line1, locality, postal_code and jurisdiction (line2 is optional; jurisdiction is an ISO 3166-2 code like US-ID, and a US shop also accepts ID, id, or Idaho), for example {"line1":"100 Test St","locality":"Boise","postal_code":"83702","jurisdiction":"US-ID"}

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-2 like US-ID. ID, id, and Idaho are accepted for a US shop.

name: requests_convert
